snippet.title: Rune Factory: Tides of Destiny (2009/2011) Playthrough (PS3)
snippet.description:
Ok folks, here is a playthrough to an action role playing game inspired by the likes of Atelier and Tales and it's Rune Factory: Tides of Destiny released in the fall of 2011 on the Playstation 3 which was a port of the original Wii game that came out in either 2009 or 2010. Anyways, this series like Etrian Odyssey has always been stuck on Nintendo consoles with the exception of this one. It's odd how this series along with Etrian Odyssey never saw a game release on the Playstation Portable. Now, I've never owned a Rune Factory game before, so this is my first time owning a game of this JRPG franchise. Maybe one day I could own one of these games on my DS, 3DS or Nintendo Switch. I bought my copy on August 26th, 2023 from Next Level in Saskatoon. After seeing footage of this game on VGL, I was interested in playing it. And well, it's not bad. In my playthrough I didn't play through a bunch of fights, but just a few. It was mostly exploring around the various areas in this game. If Rune Factory appeals to you, then you can check this game out. 

What's interesting about this game is that it has Playstation Move compatibility. I don't own a PSM unit because that thing didn't sell very well unlike the Wii and Xbox 360 Kinect. 

All rights belong to Marvelous Entertainment and Natsume.
